primary_claim.statement: On fresh seeds 400-459 at N_DIM in {16,24,32,40,50}, Fisher-combined Spearman p-values for (omega(A), M1) are significant at alpha=0.05.
kill_criteria: REJECTED if fisher_combined_p >= 0.05 on preregistered fresh seeds
Do not upgrade from exploratory H-B2-1n Fisher after seeing data
alternative_explanations: Sample-specific noise in H-B2-1n exploratory window
Effect concentrated at moderate N only (scope limitation)
reopen_conditions: Pre-registered fixed-grid at larger N with new seeds
